test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the tone of the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Cautionary**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage adopts a **cautionary tone** by presenting alarming statistics and facts about the detrimental effects of human activities on the planet.
 
• It highlights significant environmental degradation, such as deforestation, wildlife decline, land and ocean degradation, and increasing CO2 emissions.
 
• The purpose of this tone is to warn and alert readers to the urgency of these issues.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Entertaining:** This tone is characterized by humour or enjoyment and doesn't fit the serious and alarming nature of the passage.
 
• **Persuasive:** While the passage aims to raise awareness, its primary goal is to warn rather than to persuade readers into action or belief directly.
 
• **Narrative:** This tone is used for storytelling, whereas the passage focuses on presenting facts and statistics.
